title: Liebermann Villa

nativeAxes.z: northwest toward the street and kitchen garden

geometryLabel: Mapped villa rectangle; separate garden house and neighboring Villa Hamspohn excluded. Terrace extension is interpreted from local photographs.

orientationControl.basis: Mapped rectangle and official museum description: two columns on street side, pediment on lake side. Distinct local photos of both elevations.

terrainContact.basis: Street-side central garden approach outside the entrance steps.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap villa footprint, local Qualla front/terrace photographs and official museum architecture description.
identityStatus: Restored Liebermann Villa museum; separate garden house and adjacent Hamspohn villa are excluded.
notes: Map rectangle controls the roughly 19.45 by 14.29 m main building. Street portico, lake risalit, side loggia and terrace are interpreted from photographs; reported map height 8 m does not include a reliable roof measurement.
limitations: Not a building survey; roof height, eyebrow profile, fine capitals and terrace depth are photo-derived.
Terrace extension is not separately mapped, and exact historical dimensions are not claimed.
